process_description: A support agent receives a customer ticket, verifies the issue and account, searches policy and product information, diagnoses the request, communicates a resolution, escalates exceptions, and closes the case.

transformation_context.description: An LLM retrieves relevant policy information and drafts a response. A support agent reviews the draft, handles exceptions, approves the final response, and sends it.

process_description: A claims specialist receives a claim, verifies coverage and claimant identity, gathers documents, assesses damage and liability, requests missing evidence, determines a settlement, obtains approvals, communicates the decision, and records the claim.

task_context.controls: coverage rules, fraud controls, approval thresholds
task_context.inputs: claim form, policy, evidence, adjuster reports

transformation_context.description: A model extracts claim facts, checks policy clauses, and drafts a preliminary assessment. A claims specialist reviews evidence, resolves exceptions, approves settlement authority, and communicates the decision.

process_description: An accounts-payable team receives supplier invoices, extracts invoice fields, matches invoices to purchase orders and receipts, investigates mismatches, obtains approval, schedules payment, handles supplier queries, and maintains records.

task_context.controls: three-way match, approval limits, tax checks

transformation_context.description: Document extraction and matching are automated, while an AP analyst reviews exceptions, approves ambiguous matches, resolves supplier disputes, and releases payments.

process_description: An engineering team receives bug reports, reproduces issues, checks logs and recent changes, assesses severity and user impact, identifies duplicates, assigns ownership, communicates status, and prioritizes work for a release.

task_context.controls: severity policy, release risk, incident escalation

transformation_context.description: An LLM summarizes reports, suggests duplicate matches, and drafts severity and routing recommendations. An engineer verifies reproduction, assesses risk, decides priority, and approves assignment.

process_description: A sales development team receives inbound leads, enriches company and contact data, checks fit criteria, researches the account, contacts the prospect, qualifies needs and timing, records the outcome, and routes qualified opportunities.

task_context.controls: territory, consent, fit and disqualification rules

transformation_context.description: A model enriches lead records, summarizes public account information, and drafts outreach. A seller reviews fit, decides qualification, conducts the conversation, and approves routing.

process_description: Human resources receives a new-hire record, verifies employment and identity information, collects documents, creates accounts and access, schedules orientation, coordinates equipment, assigns training, and confirms readiness with the manager.

transformation_context.description: Workflow automation prepares forms, creates standard tasks, and drafts onboarding communications. HR and IT review identity-sensitive exceptions, approve access, coordinate equipment, and confirm completion.

process_description: A legal or procurement team receives a contract, identifies parties and scope, checks required clauses, compares terms to policy and fallback positions, assesses commercial and legal risk, negotiates changes, obtains approvals, and records the executed agreement.

task_context.controls: approved clauses, authority limits, legal risk

transformation_context.description: An LLM extracts clauses, compares them with the playbook, and drafts issue summaries and fallback language. Counsel reviews risk, negotiates material terms, approves exceptions, and signs off.

process_description: A scheduling team receives a patient request, verifies identity and contact details, determines appointment type and urgency, checks provider and resource availability, handles insurance or referral requirements, books the appointment, sends instructions, and manages changes or cancellations.

transformation_context.description: A scheduling assistant collects request details, proposes available slots, and drafts reminders. A scheduler handles urgent, ambiguous, privacy-sensitive, or referral exceptions and confirms the booking.

process_description: A quality inspector receives a production lot, identifies inspection requirements, samples units, performs measurements and visual checks, records results, investigates defects, decides disposition, escalates safety or recurring issues, and releases or quarantines the lot.

task_context.controls: sampling plan, tolerances, safety, nonconformance process

transformation_context.description: Computer vision and sensor analytics flag likely defects and prepare inspection records. An inspector validates borderline findings, investigates nonconformance, decides disposition, and approves lot release.

process_description: An adviser team receives a prospective client, verifies identity, collects financial and suitability information, performs know-your-customer checks, understands goals and risk tolerance, prepares recommendations, obtains approvals, opens accounts, and documents the relationship.

task_context.controls: KYC, suitability, privacy, approval and recordkeeping

transformation_context.description: A system extracts client documents, drafts a profile and meeting summary, and prepares standard account-opening forms. An adviser and compliance reviewer verify identity, assess suitability, approve exceptions, and make recommendations.

process_description: A procurement operations team receives a purchase request, checks budget and policy, validates supplier and coding, routes approvals, resolves price or quantity exceptions, issues or changes a purchase order, and records the decision for audit.

transformation_context.description: Workflow automation checks standard policy and prepares purchase-order drafts. A buyer reviews nonstandard suppliers, price or quantity exceptions, obtains approvals, and records the final decision.

process_description: An IT service desk receives an access request, verifies the requester and manager, identifies the requested system and role, checks entitlement policy, obtains approvals, provisions or changes access, confirms completion, and reviews or removes access when required.

task_context.controls: least privilege, manager approval, segregation of duties, audit

transformation_context.description: A workflow assistant classifies requests, checks standard role mappings, drafts approval tasks, and prepares provisioning instructions. An administrator reviews exceptions, approves privileged access, provisions sensitive roles, and confirms completion.
